balloons_1: Balloons! They never light, but they bounce the ball off at whatever angle it strikes them.
balloons_2: Use them for a ricochet, or curse them when they're in the way.
boss_boar_2: The Mechano-Boar turns tail every time it's hit. Learn its charge and lead your shots.
boss_drake_1: Hssss! Intruder! Tin Drake online. Dent me, and I only fly faster!
boss_drake_2: A rogue drake from the workshop! Get the ball down past the pegs and keep hitting it.
boss_golem_2: Its shield is up from the start and comes back every third shot. It stops your lightning too: two hits or two bolts break it.
boss_spider_1: Skitter skitter. You will never pin the Gyro Spider down.
boss_spider_2: Your oranges only charge it up. Strike it in the same shot to let the charge loose, and watch out: it jumps when you hit it.
boss_yeti_1: Cog Yeti repairs. Cog Yeti always repairs.
boss_yeti_2: Miss it and it heals. Every shot has to count!
bricks_1: Bricks! They light up just like pegs, and they make lovely ramps.
crazy_guide_1: You did it! Did you see his face? As promised: my Super Guide is now the Crazy Guide.
crazy_guide_2: Five bounces of the path, every time you earn it. Don't tell Cogwhistle how it works!
duel_1: Well, well. My brother's little peg machine. Still playing, I see.
duel_2: Cogwhistle Overspark, Tinkmaster's brother! Clear this board first, friend, then he'll want a duel. Five balls each.
duel_3: And every shot that lights no orange costs you five hundred. Do try to keep up.
eggs3_1: These eggs are tougher: three hits to hatch one now.
eggs_1: Phoenix eggs! Two hits hatch one, and the phoenix bursts straight up through everything above it.
eggs_2: But mind the bricks holding them. Knock a cradle away and the egg falls. Catch it in the bucket, or the level is lost!
gears_help_1: Golden Gears, is it? They're the pachinko's own coin. One gold buys one gear.
gears_help_2: Walk up to any mailbox and press Get Golden Gears again. I'll fill the mail out for you: gold to Chairface Chippendale, with pachinko golden gears as the subject.
gears_help_3: But mind this: I will not, and I cannot, press Send for you. The Blizzard... ahem, the Gnomish Regulators forbid it! That last button is yours to press.
gears_help_4: Send it off, and your gears turn up as soon as the gold arrives. Spend them in the shop on special balls, or on more plays!
gems_1: Gems on ledges. Hitting a gem only shoves it: knock out the bricks under it and let it drop off the bottom.
gems_2: One that lands in the bucket is a Bucket Drop bonus!
gim_blocks_1: Steel blocks. They never light and never break, so bank off them to reach what's behind.
gim_key_cage_1: A cage! Those oranges are locked in. Light the gold key somewhere on the board and the cage falls away.
gim_lifts_1: Lifts! These pegs rise and sink in turn. Wait for the one you want to come up to meet you.
gim_pendulum_1: A pendulum on its chain. Catch it at the end of its swing and it flings the ball along with it.
gim_slider_1: A Slider! That row glides back and forth. Aim for where it will be, not where it is.
gimmick_1_bink: Moving parts! Time your shot, or use them to bank the ball where you want it.
gimmick_1_mekka: Moving parts! Time your shot, or use them to bank the ball where you want it.
gimmick_1_razzle: Moving parts! Time your shot, or use them to bank the ball where you want it.
gimmick_1_tink: Moving parts! Time your shot, or use them to bank the ball where you want it.
green_peg_1: One more toy for you: the Extra Green Peg. It's the new button under the special balls.
green_peg_2: Click it on the level card, before you press Play, and the board gets one more green peg. Here's one to try!
heavy_1: Gold-rimmed pegs! These take three hits each. Keep at them.
host_bink_1: Hello hello! Bink, apprentice extraordinaire. It's my turn to run the machine!
host_bink_2: My powers are a little magical: a Fireball that burns straight through pegs, and a Spooky Ball that comes back from the bottom.
host_mekka_1: High Tinker Mekkatorque, at your service. Tinkmaster tells me you're rather good at this.
host_mekka_2: While I host, the green pegs give you my inventions: Space Blast, or Chain Lightning. Choose wisely!
host_razzle_1: Razzle Sprysprocket here! I've got the fun toys this chapter.
host_razzle_2: My Pyramid bounces your ball back up from the bottom, and Free Ball Frenzy hands you an extra ball. Have at it!
intro_1: Fair warning: the bosses are still a work in progress. They may change completely in a later version.
intro_2: Got ideas? New gnome hosts with new powers, new obstacles, new bosses? Send them in on the Gnomish Pachinko page on CurseForge!
intro_3: And you can build boards of your own! Press Level editor under the map, make a level, and post its code on CurseForge. The best go into the machine, with your name on them!
intro_4: Now, enough chatter! Step right up, grab the lever, and give her a whirl. Go on, off you go, and mind the sparks!
items_1: See the buttons to the left of the board? Those are my special balls.
items_2: Ring of Fire burns a small circle, Rainbow Ball a big one, and the Suction Tube pulls a falling ball into the bucket. Click one before you shoot.
items_3: Here's one of each, on the house. Go on, give them a try!
keys_1_bink: A key! Light it and its cage falls away. Sometimes the key is locked behind another cage.
keys_1_mekka: A key! Light it and its cage falls away. Sometimes the key is locked behind another cage.
keys_1_razzle: A key! Light it and its cage falls away. Sometimes the key is locked behind another cage.
keys_1_tink: A key! Light it and its cage falls away. Sometimes the key is locked behind another cage.
longshots_1: Long Shots! Light two orange pegs far apart in one shot. Bank it off a wall and let it fly across.
mixed_1: Two jobs at once from here on: the orange pegs and the eggs or gems. Both, or no clear!
nobucket_1: No bucket on this one. The only free balls are the score marks, so make every ball count.
purple_1: See the purple peg? It's worth a thousand points, and it hops to a new spot after every shot.
rails_1: Another rail! Catch the inside of it and the ball rides the whole curve, lighting every brick.
silver_cage_1: A cage inside a cage! The gold key sits behind silver bars, so find the silver key first.
slide_1: Now this is a beauty: a spiral of bricks.
slide_2: It's a rail! Drop the ball into its mouth on the left and it runs along the inside like a road, all the way round. That's a Super Slide!
slide_3: Hold the right mouse button to zoom in and line the shot up with the mouth. Go on, clear the whole spiral in one shot.
tink_duel_1: Well, well. Little brother. Still hiding behind your helpers?
tink_duel_2: No helpers this time, Cogwhistle. This one is between you and me.
tink_duel_3: Clear the board, then five balls each, and the higher score takes it. Try not to cry.
tink_duel_4: Win this one for me, friend, and I will show you something special. My Crazy Guide!
tough_1: Steel-rimmed pieces take two hits, gold-rimmed three. Each hit strips a layer: gold to steel, steel to a plain peg.
welcome_1: Well hello there! Tinkmaster Overspark, chief engineer of Tinker Town, at your service.
welcome_2: This is my finest invention: the Gnomish Pachinko Machine! Point with the mouse, click to shoot.
welcome_3: Light every orange peg and the board is yours. Ten balls a level.
welcome_4: Hit a green peg and you get my power: Multiball, or my Super Guide. Pick one on the level card before you start.
